title: BR-042 intake — ingest-audit browse lane is half-landed (queue entry only, no code change)
intent: Register one bounded maintenance defect discovered by a Tier D stranded-branch audit. main ships services/api/app/rmos/acoustics/router_ingest_audit.py with three working endpoints that NO code mounts, plus a frontend view deliberately gated because that lane is unmounted. The missing half - the mount and a full 717-line view - survives on salvage/other-stash8-ingest-audit-binaries at f102380d. Every claim was re-witnessed against origin/main 9d22aa61 rather than inherited from the source Dev Order. This patch adds the queue entry and defines scope; it authorizes no implementation.
behavior_change: None. Documentation only - one defect-register entry. No code, route, schema, or runtime behaviour changes. The defect it describes remains unfixed and explicitly unauthorized, blocked on an owner ruling.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds a Tier D intake section and BR-042, with the per-fact evidence table, the bounded scope, and an explicit blocking flag for the governance conflict.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The feature is unreachable in production while both halves exist in the repository, and the recoverable half sits on a local-only salvage branch that would be lost if that branch were pruned. The entry also records the recovery SHA so the work survives branch deletion.

commands_run: git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main | grep router_ingest_audit -> router present at services/api/app/rmos/acoustics/router_ingest_audit.py.
git grep router_ingest_audit origin/main -> 5 references, ALL docs/metrics; zero include_router mount sites. metrics/wire_url_audit.json tags it 'UNMANIFESTED:'.
git grep on the gated view -> gating comments at lines 10 and 345; no API calls and no endpoint strings present.
git grep on f102380d -> mount at main.py:1186-1194 with prefix=/api/rmos/acoustics; IngestEventsView.vue fetches /api/rmos/acoustics/ingest-events, /counts and /{eventId}.
Router declares /ingest-events, /ingest-events/counts, /ingest-events/{event_id} -> all three align with the salvage view.
Prefix convention cross-checked against router_import.py and router_zip_export.py, both 'prefix set once in main.py'.
Probes deliberately avoided `git show <ref>:<path>` / `git cat-file -e <ref>:<path>`, which silently yield false-absent results under Git Bash on Windows via MSYS path conversion.
verification.known_residual: BR-042 CONFLICTS with a standing governance ruling. SYSTEM_CONFLATION_AUDIT_2026-06-21.md:123 rules this pair 'RETIRE / broken pair' because 'FE fetches /acoustics_ingest/ ... paths diverge'. That basis could not be reproduced: line 209 of the gated view is a Vue component import from a directory named acoustics_ingest/, not a fetch URL, and the view has no API calls at all. Executing BR-042 would reverse a RETIRE decision, so the entry is filed QUEUED and blocked on an owner ruling rather than presented as a straightforward defect.

files.intent: Add BR-042 with re-witnessed evidence, bounded scope, the recovery SHA, and an explicit owner-ruling blocker for the conflicting RETIRE decision.
